role: CI gate: CBCentralManager/CBPeripheralManager/PolarBleApiDefaultImpl.polarImplementation must not be built in a non-lazy stored property or inside init(), and init() must not unconditionally read a lazy/computed builder property.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to repo root. Python ROOTS Emuqu/Sources, watch app, Emuqu/EmuquApp.swift (a missing root -> exit 2); code_lines strips // tails; builder_properties at brace depth <=1; builder_functions = methods in the same file whose body constructs a prompting type, reads a builder property, or (transitively) calls such a method; scan tracks init bodies by brace depth and flags constructions at stored-property depth (non-lazy), inside init, top-level init reads of builder properties, and top-level init calls of builder methods (braced sub-blocks removed). Problems -> exit 1; else clean with file count.
